newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian has surgery to remove 22-year-old foetus.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian has surgery to remove 22-year-old foetus.

text.p: A 52-year-old Brazilian woman had surgery on Wednesday to remove a foetus lodged in her stomach for 22 years, her doctor said.

"This is a rare case of an ectopic pregnancy and the 8-month-old foetus mummified and stayed in her body," said Zamir Ciraudo, the surgeon who carried out the operation at a hospital in Campo Grande, west of Rio de Janeiro.
An ectopic pregnancy means the embryo develops outside the woman's uterus.

Wanda Maria da Conceicao was not the first woman in Brazil to experience this problem. In April this year, doctors operated on a 62-year-old woman who was carrying the skeleton of a foetus that grew outside her womb up to 15 years earlier.
The doctor said Conceicao had known all along the foetus was there, but she never wanted to do anything about it until recently when it started to cause her some pain.
Conceicao, who has five children, is recovering well in hospital and was scheduled to return home in three days.
